name: Patanjali
shortBio: Classical Indian philosopher and compiler of the Yoga Sutras (c. 2nd century BCE – 4th century CE) who systematized Ashtanga Yoga as an empirical psychology of attention, cognitive restraint (citta-vritti-nirodha), and liberating discrimination.
centralQuestion: How can disciplined attentional and ethical practice quiet the fluctuations of mind (citta-vritti) to uncover pure witnessing consciousness?

keyWorks.title: Yoga Sutras of Patanjali
keyWorks.description: Foundational 195-aphorism treatise of Raja Yoga analyzing mental afflictions (kleshas), meditative absorption (samadhi), and the eight-limbed path.
